stories.title: President House says matters related to provinces did not come under discussion during Zardari, Naqvi meeting
stories.brief: The President House on Friday refuted media reports about yesterday’s meeting between President Asif Ali Zardari and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, saying that discussions focused on national security and regional situation.

stories.title: No provincial matters discussed at Zardari-Naqvi meeting in Nawabshah: President House
stories.brief: The President’s House on Friday issued a clarification regarding a meeting between President Asif Ali Zardari and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, rejecting media reports suggesting that provincial matters had come under discussion.

stories.title: ECP warns of orders if PMO fails to submit request for cantonment polls
stories.brief: The commission issued the direction in an order passed on November 10 by a five-member bench headed by Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja, while hearing a case regarding the delay in holding local government elections in 42 cantonment boards across the country.

stories.title: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement, Turkish presidency says
stories.brief: Turkiye and Qatar signed a mutual defence agreement on Friday, ​the office of President Tayyip Erdogan said, as ‌the Turkish leader met the Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al-Thani in Istanbul. "President Erdogan stated that the Mutual Defence Agreement ‌signed ⁠today by Turkiye and Qatar would add another dimension to our brotherhood," it added.

stories.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
stories.brief: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.

stories.title: SpaceX to attempt double catch of huge Starship rocket
stories.brief: Elon Musk’s company will try to grab both parts of the rocket for the first time.

stories.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
stories.brief: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.

stories.title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
stories.brief: Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.

stories.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
stories.brief: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

stories.title: What happened overnight with the Microsoft global outage?
stories.brief: Microsoft is struggling to fix a global outage, with services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot affected by "connectivity problems".

stories.title: Turkiye, Qatar sign defence agreement: Turkish presidency
stories.brief: Turkiye and Qatar signed a defence agreement on Friday that President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said would further strengthen ties between the regional allies, his office said. In August, Turkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan signed a joint defence agreement in Makkah, bringing together the Sunni Muslim US allies at a time of conflict across the region.

stories.title: Legislature cannot be 'bypassed', minister says on question of referendum on new provinces
stories.brief: Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Tariq Fazal Chaudhry said on Friday that Parliament and the provincial assemblies could not be "bypassed or negated" on the question of making new provinces through a referendum to determine the public will.

stories.title: IHC suspends Islamabad local govt election schedule
stories.brief: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Friday suspended the Election Commission of Pakistan's (ECP) schedule for local government elections in the federal capital, which were scheduled for December 20, and sought responses from the commission and other respondents by November 26.

stories.title: Security forces kill 74 terrorists in K-P, Balochistan operations: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed 74 terrorists during intelligence-based operations in Balochistan and Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Friday. He said the recovery of weapons, ammunition and explosives from the terrorists' possession demonstrated the effectiveness of the security forces' operations.

stories.title: FAA issues nationwide ground stop for all U.S. airports
stories.brief: The FAA has issued a nationwide ground stop for all U.S. airports following a "communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers," according to Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy.(Image credit: Bruce Bennett)

stories.brief: Kurt Gödel left 1,009 pages of densely written text – much of it in an obsolete shorthand – which is now said to contain hundreds of proved theoremsThe Austrian logician Kurt Gödel was one of the most original thinkers of the 20th century.
